cohort: The study participants were 1000 mothers from Bettiah, West Champaran, Bihar, India, who had a child less than 12 months of age.
finding: The prevalence of timely initiation of breastfeeding was 80%, with factors such as having a male infant, living in a nuclear family, spontaneous vaginal delivery, and counseling on timely initiation of breastfeeding during ANC significantly associated with early initiation.
mod_finding: Spontaneous vaginal delivery was identified as a factor positively associated with timely initiation of breastfeeding.
cross-section timing: Mothers with children less than 12 months old at the time of the study.
